exposure: same obstetrician in prenatal and childbirth
Same obstetrician in prenatal and childbirth
finding: The study found a high prevalence of planned cesarean sections (38%) among low-risk women in Southern Brazil, contributing to an overall cesarean section rate of 50.5%, with planned cesarean sections being significantly associated with factors such as age ≥ 35 years, higher economic class, pregnancy between 37 and 38 weeks, having the same obstetrician during prenatal care and childbirth, and private payment source at birth.
mod_finding: This study found a high rate of planned cesarean sections in low-risk women, which was not associated with socioeconomic, obstetric, institutional, or prenatal factors.
